title: Consolidate CI bootstrappers and add presubmit smoke layer
author: Maya Khatri
description: Motivation: reduce presubmit latency and maintenance cost by consolidating multiple ad-hoc bootstrappers (make, bash helpers, python shims) into a single minimal Go-based CI bootstrapper, and introduce a lightweight presubmit smoke lane that runs a deterministic subset of integration checks for quick feedback. This PR: 1) Adds tools/ci/bootstrap (Go) which replaces legacy scripts used during runner init; 2) Rewires .github/workflows/ci.yml to call the bootstrap binary and normalizes environment variables across runners; 3) Introduces .github/workflows/presubmit-smoke.yml which runs fast smoke checks (lint quick, unit tests with cached deps, basic runtime compatibility tests) on PRs to provide < 3m feedback for common changes; 4) Removes/archives legacy scripts in build/bootstrap/{Makefile,ci-bootstrap.sh,presubmit_helper.py} and documents the migration in docs/dev/ci_bootstrap.md. Checklist: - [x] Add Go bootstrap CLI and unit tests - [x] Wire up CI workflows and secrets handling - [x] Add smoke workflow and small test matrix for linux/amd64 and linux/arm64 - [x] Migrate a sample repo path (redwood-sdk-python) to exercise new bootstrap - [x] Update developer docs and devcontainer quickstart Notes: preserved compatibility flags for long-running release pipelines (release/* branches still run old bootstrap until a staged rollout completes). Linear tasks ENG-2042 and ENG-2068 track full rollout and rollout telemetry respectively.

name: presubmit-smoke
on: [pull_request]
jobs:

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: bootstrap
        run: tools/ci/bootstrap --fast

Maya Khatri: Good point, added a --trace-output flag and wired it into release pipelines as optional. See commit 8f3b9c2.
Riley Thompson: Found a small race in toolcache prefetch while running on arm64 runners; added a fix request.
Maya Khatri: Pushed a follow-up commit to address the arm64 race (check-and-create temporary dir). CI re-ran and passed.
Samira Gupta: Approval after second green run; smoke workflow trimmed down to keep runtime <3m on ubuntu-latest.
ci_checks: release-pipeline-smoke - passed after rerun (one transient docker pull timeout)
release_notes: Introduce a consolidated Go-based CI bootstrapper and a fast presubmit smoke workflow. Improves PR feedback time and unifies environment initialization across runners. No user-facing breaking changes.
notes_for_ops: Rollout plan: keep legacy bootstrap available on release/* for two weeks, flip feature flag ing.eng.ci.bootstrap.unified=on after telemetry shows stable presubmit success rate. If problems observed, revert by restoring the archived scripts (build/bootstrap/*) and reverting workflow change. Telemetry: presubmit latency and smoke hit-rate tracked in ENG-2068.
